ideas.pitch: An interactive execution visualizer for complex graph and tree algorithms that explains state changes in real-time.
ideas.title: AlgoTrace Visualizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly appeals to a judges' panel focused on DSA mastery by breaking down hard-to-visualize concepts like Red-Black trees or Dijkstra step-by-step.

ideas.pitch: A benchmarking and optimization suite for competitive programmers to profile memory and execution time of C++ vs Python implementations.
ideas.title: BitwiseBench
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a core pain point for advanced participants optimizing solutions for tight time limits in DSA rounds.

ideas.pitch: A smart hints generator that analyses a user's failing code during a DSA challenge and provides Socratic nudges instead of full solutions.
ideas.title: RecurseMentor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the educational and testing spirit of a girls-only coding challenge by helping learners improve problem-solving fundamentals.

ideas.pitch: A static analysis tool that scans submitted Python or C++ solutions and accurately predicts time and space complexity using abstract syntax trees.
ideas.title: ComplexityPred
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates genuinely hard engineering by parsing code structures to evaluate Big-O efficiency automatically without running test cases.

ideas.pitch: A spaced-repetition flashcard platform specifically generated from missed questions in fundamental computer science and DSA quizzes.
ideas.title: DataStructDeck
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the format of Round 1 quizzes by bridging the gap between testing knowledge and long-term retention.
